cases.name: missing and null
cases.source: function run(id) assert(getChat(id,99)==nil); assert(getChat(id,1).role==nil); assert(getChat(id,3).data==nil); return getChatMain(id,3) end

cases.name: fresh recursive decoded copies
cases.source: function run(id) local a=getChat(id,1); a.data.a[2]='changed'; a.data.z=99; local b=getChat(id,1); assert(b.data.z==1); return tostring(b.data.a[2]) end

cases.name: state null holes unicode and changed arity
cases.source: function run(id) assert(getState(id,'missing')==nil); assert(select('#',setState(id,'value',{7,false,'a'..string.char(0)..'b','😀'}))==0); local v=getState(id,'value'); assert(v[3]=='a'..string.char(0)..'b' and v[4]=='😀'); assert(select('#',setStateChanged(id,'value',{7,false,'a'..string.char(0)..'b','😀'}))==0); assert(setStateChanged(id,'changed',true)==true); return getChatVar(id,'__value') end

cases.name: partial state errors
cases.source: function run(id) setState(id,'before',true); local cycle={}; cycle.self=cycle; assert(not pcall(setState,id,'bad',cycle)); assert(not pcall(setState,id,'bad',0/0)); return getChatVar(id,'__before') end

cases.name: lexical decoder replacement
cases.source: decodeJSON=function(_) return 'lexical' end; function run(id) return getState(id,'x')..':'..getChat(id,0) end

cases.name: global decoder replacement
cases.source: function run(id) getChat(id,0); json.decode=function(_) return 'override' end; return getChat(id,0) end

cases.name: decoder dependencies remain observable
cases.source: function run(id) setChatVar(id,'__key','"\\u0061"'); local first=getState(id,'key'); local old=string.char; string.char=function() return 'changed' end; local second=getState(id,'key'); string.char=old; return first..':'..second..':'..getState(id,'key') end

cases.name: discarded function collision after both key passes
cases.source: function run(id) local t={}; local order={}; local n=0; local function key() return setmetatable({}, {__tostring=function(self) n=n+1; if n<=2 then order[n]=self end; if n==2 then t[order[1]]=function() end; t[order[2]]=2 end; return 'same' end}) end; t[key()]=0; t[key()]=0; assert(#getRecentChats(id,t)==4 and n==4); return true end

cases.name: state names retain Lua concatenation
cases.source: function run(id) setState(id,7,'number'); local name=setmetatable({}, {__concat=function(prefix,_) assert(prefix=='__'); return '__custom' end}); setState(id,name,true); return getState(id,7)..':'..tostring(getState(id,name)) end
